pages:
Cover letter

Applicant: Cedar Row Pharma, 14 Dock Street, Alderbank.

We submit this application for a new registration, abridged route, for Dilmerol 40 mg tablets. The quality, nonclinical and clinical modules follow the common technical document structure. Please send questions to the regulatory affairs office at the address above.

Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Dilmerol 40 mg tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each tablet contains 40 mg of dilmerol.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 30 months.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Do not store above 30 C.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

Alu/Alu blisters in cartons of 28 tablets.

3.2.P.3 Manufacture

3.2.P.3.1 Manufacturer(s)

The name and address of the finished product manufacturer will be confirmed in the final submission. The manufacturer holds a current certificate of good manufacturing practice, number CR-GMP-0220.

3.2.P.3.2 Batch formula

The commercial batch size will be defined after process validation. Three pilot-scale batches were made for the stability study.

Stability report: Dilmerol 40 mg tablets

Contents

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion ........ page 2
3.2.P.8.3 Stability data ........ page 3

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Dilmerol 40 mg tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 30 months is proposed when the product is stored below 30 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 30 C / 65% RH | 30 | 65 | 18 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

The long-term study was stored at 30 C / 65% RH. 18 months of long-term data are available for all three batches.
